# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities through GitHub private vulnerability reporting:
[open a private advisory](https://github.com/thaddeus-run/thaddeus/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue or discussion for a vulnerability.

This covers the `thaddeus` CLI, the server (`thaddeus serve`), the hosted server
at `ams1.thaddeus.run`, and the install path (the install script, the npm
packages, and the release binaries). Include the affected version and the steps
to reproduce the problem.

Please do not disclose a vulnerability publicly until a fix is released.
